fixture_label: SYNTHETIC example; fictional customer and product policies

support.question: How do I invite a teammate?

knowledge.title: Invite a teammate
knowledge.body: Open Members, choose Invite, enter the teammate's email, and select Send invitation. Only team admins can send invitations.

knowledge.title: Verify your email
knowledge.body: Open the synthetic welcome email and select Verify address. If it is missing, choose Resend verification from account settings.

knowledge.title: Create a project
knowledge.body: Open Projects and select New project. Enter a name and save.
